settings.heading: Scoop. Shake. Eat.
settings.body: Cheat Shot is a dietary supplement, not a medication. It complements, but does not replace, balanced eating and healthy habits.*

settings.name: Magnesium
settings.description: As Magnesium Taurinate. An essential mineral that contributes to normal energy-yielding metabolism and normal muscle function.

settings.name: Chromium
settings.description: As Chromium Picolinate. A trace mineral that contributes to normal macronutrient metabolism.

settings.name: Taurine
settings.description: An amino acid found naturally in the body and included here at a full 2 gram serving.

settings.name: Alpha Lipoic Acid (ALA)
settings.description: A compound the body produces naturally, included as part of the powder blend.

settings.name: L-Glutathione (Reduced)
settings.description: The reduced, bioavailable form of glutathione.

settings.name: Pterostilbene
settings.description: A polyphenol found naturally in blueberries.

settings.heading: What's inside.
settings.body: 30 servings per container. Every ingredient, every dose. No proprietary blends. Other ingredients: citric acid, natural flavors, sucralose, beet root powder (for natural color), silicon dioxide, beta carotene (for natural color).

settings.question: What does the powder taste like?
settings.answer: It mixes into water or your usual drink. See the product description for flavour details.

Is it safe to take with medication?
settings.answer: Talk to your healthcare provider before use if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication, or have a medical condition.
